tests.narrative: SDSS DR7 (Zehavi et al. 2011): D_eff flows from 1.55 at r<10 Mpc/h to 0.31 at r>30 Mpc/h. Overall γ=1.794 (D_eff=1.21, R²=0.9802). No clear flow. Analysis computed dynamically from published correlation function data.

tests.name: NIST Hydrogen (H): energy level ratio law (15 levels)
tests.narrative: Hydrogen energy levels (n=15): ranked ratios fit m_n/m_1 = n^(1/D_eff) with D_eff=9.4057 (R²=0.8184). Ratio law not well-fit. Data fetched live from NIST ASD. Slope=0.1063±0.0139.

tests.name: NUBASE/AME2020 nuclear mass ratio law (295 nuclei)

tests.name: LIGO/Virgo: 100 gravitational wave events (50 BBH, 0 BNS, 0 NSBH)
tests.narrative: LIGO/Virgo detected 100 gravitational wave events (50 BBH, 0 BNS, 0 NSBH in recent 50). Binary inspiral ringdown signals persist as coherent structure across detector network despite noise smoothing — consistent with T4: structure survives retention (R_corr² > R_HF). The detection of ringdown modes (quasi-normal modes) confirms that structural information (black hole mass/spin) is retained even as HF inspiral detail is smoothed by detector noise.

tests.name: Hubble Frontier Fields: Abell 2744 arc/ring skeleton persistence
tests.narrative: Abell 2744: strong lensing arcs/rings persist across VIS/NIR angular smoothing scales. The two-channel split (R_HF ≺ R_corr²) is visually confirmed — arc skeleton survives while individual star-forming knots wash out. Quantitative λ_q measurement requires dedicated multi-scale pipeline (pending). Data: Hubble Frontier Fields public release.
